column4: cleat#2641/#2645: MySQL-only by nature, not by omission -- it settles whether InnoDB's REPEATABLE READ locking reads take next-key locks on unrelated rows scanned via idx_ingested_events_unprocessed (a question specific to MySQL's locking model; PostgreSQL has no equivalent gap-lock behavior for this query shape). Checks os.Getenv via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectMySQL) directly (no subtests), so it skips once, at the top level, in ci.yml's test-go/plugins job (PostgreSQL only via CLEAT_TEST_DB) and runs wherever CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL is set. Measured: go test ./plugins/eventtriggers/... -run TestAwaitEventConcurrentClaimsOfDifferentEventTypesDoNotInterfereOnMySQL -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset reports exactly this one skip.
